content.title: The Last Sunrise
content.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

Title: The Last Sunrise

Tagline: One summer to feel everything.

Overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

Genres: Romance, Drama

Production Companies: Amazon MGM Studios, Ethea Entertainment, Luber-Roklin Entertainment, Pitt Street Productions, Aquarius Films, The Last Sunrise

Production Countries: United States of America, Spain

Spoken Languages: English
